Daniel — thanks for the detailed note and the security doc. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

Summary / recommendation
- Given your requirement for IP-sensitive workloads and quarterly offline patching, Private VPC / on-prem (air-gapped) is the best fit. Dedicated capacity is an option if you want a managed but non-airgapped path, and Hosted API is only recommended for non-sensitive workloads.

Key items you asked about
- Hardware: Redwood supports standard PCIe GPU servers (A100/H100 classes) and common OEMs (HPE, Dell, Supermicro). We’ll validate exact GPU SKUs during the HW inventory review.
- Upgrades & offline ops: We supply an upgrade package (signed artifacts + checksums) and a documented MOP (method of procedure) for air-gapped installs. The process supports offline validation and rollback; we also provide an on-prem runbook and optional on-site or remote-assisted install.
- Audit items: We can provide logs for model loads, user actions, and OS-level patch history; KMS/HSM integrations are supported (bring-your-own-KMS). We’ll include SOC-like artifacts for the items in your attachment where applicable.
- Lead time: typical lead time for an initial on-prem appliance + software package is 6–8 weeks after PO, subject to hardware procurement windows.

Next steps / action items (proposed)
1) Please complete the attached HW inventory template (hw-inventory-template.xlsx) with node counts, current GPU SKUs, and network topology.
2) I’ll share our on-prem spec doc (redwood-onprem-specs.pdf) and the MOP draft for your ops/security teams to review.
3) Internal alignment: I’ll loop in Commercial and Delivery to provide a scoped SOW and estimated cost for Private deployment vs. Dedicated.
4) Once we have the inventory and confirmation of maintenance windows, we’ll produce a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a recommended rollout (canary -> production).

I’ve attached redwood-onprem-specs.pdf and hw-inventory-template.xlsx. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute technical readout with our infra lead (Vivek) next week to walk through the MOP and validate the inventory fields.

Best,
Irene Choi\Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
